summary: Madison County lookout that the index calls Cottener Mountain; its tower was dismantled, moved and reassembled on private property.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one index page line set and the forest's Wikipedia history. Build date, design, height and date of the move are in no source read, so there are no events. Record status 'gone' is kept: the status vocabulary has no 'moved' value and the move is stated in status_note, so the editor may want a moved flag. A search result listed a 'Cottoner Mountain' peak in Missouri (peakery.com) with a spelling variant; not verified as the same place and not used. The record coordinates (37.4637, -90.2096) are not confirmed by any source read here. The index lists the forest as Clark National Forest; it was absorbed by Mark Twain National Forest in 1976.
